micro_topic: Cell division > cytokinesis > plant vs animal cells

reconstruction.correct_statement: Animal and plant cells are very different in the Cytokinesis stage of cell division.
reconstruction.transformation: Distractors name karyokinesis phases that are common to both cells.
reconstruction.why: The cell wall prevents furrowing, so plants build a cell plate – a difference in cytokinesis, not in mitosis phases.
reconstruction.micro_topic_rule: Plant vs animal mitosis: phases same; cytokinesis differs (cell plate vs furrow); spindle origin differs (no centrioles in plants).
